label: Evapotranspiration, annual (MODIS)
source: MODIS MOD16A3GF v061 (gap-filled annual) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: mean of valid cells in county
notes: Planetary Computer only hosts the annual MOD16A3GF (no 8-day MOD16A2), so ET is annual (date = YYYY-07-01). Open water, urban and barren pixels are fill in MOD16 and excluded (e.g. permanent Sudd open water).
